unresolved.reason: G06 requires deleting the old clause “除非基金管理人在未来条件成熟后另行公告开通相关业务，本基金不同基金份额类别之间不得互相转换。”. The share-class clause still retains the old conversion prohibition language, which should have been removed.
G13 requires deleting “本基金对持续持有期少于7日的投资者收取不低于1.50%的赎回费，并将上述赎回费全额计入基金财产。”. The residual fragment “7 日的投资者收取不低于 1.5%的赎回费，并全额计入基金财产。” survives and should have been deleted.

G14 requires, for a multi-class product, changing “基金管理人可以适当调低基金申购费率和赎回费率。” to “基金管理人可以适当调低基金申购费率和销售服务费率。”. The clause still says “基金管理人可以适当调低基金申购费率和销售服务费率。” but the old “赎回费率” wording survives in the same sentence, so the required replacement was not fully applied.

G15 requires deleting the old C-class sales-service-fee payment clause (daily accrual, monthly payment, manager sends payment instruction, custodian pays within 10 working days from the first day of the next month to the registrar). The old payment mechanics survive here and were not deleted; only the new G16 text was appended after it.

G17 requires deleting the old clause describing the scope/use of C-class sales service fees (sales agency commissions, marketing/advertising, promotion, holder services, excluding募集期间). The old payment/use text remains in the sales-service-fee section and was not removed.
